hero.title: Elevate Your Beauty
hero.subtitle: Premium Medical Aesthetics in Rhodes
hero.description: Personalized treatments that refine, not redefine. Experience the art of subtle enhancement with Dr. Ioannis Michalakis.

about.title: About Dermancy
about.doctorBio: With years of clinical experience and a refined eye for balance, Dr. Michalakis has developed a unique approach to aesthetic medicine — one that respects natural beauty while restoring youthful vitality.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Enhancement Over Transformation
philosophy.description: Aesthetic medicine should never erase your identity — it should refine it. We believe in precision, minimalism, and graceful results that look as if they were always yours.

natural.title: Natural Results
natural.description: We reject overcorrection and artificial volume. Every treatment is designed to enhance your unique features.

personalized.title: Personalized Care
personalized.description: No templates, no trends. Your treatment is designed around your face, your body, and your goals.

precision.title: Clinical Precision
precision.description: Anatomical precision combined with artistic sensibility. Doctor-led care with attention to every detail.

clinic.title: The Clinic
clinic.description: A serene, discreet environment where medical excellence meets elegant care. Located in the heart of Rhodes.

treatments.title: Our Treatments
treatments.subtitle: Discover our comprehensive range of medical aesthetic treatments, each designed to enhance your natural beauty.

botox.title: Botox
botox.shortDescription: Purified neuromodulator that temporarily relaxes facial muscles for a naturally refreshed appearance.
botox.description: Botox is a purified neuromodulator (botulinum toxin) that temporarily relaxes facial muscles responsible for dynamic wrinkles. Administered with precision, it smooths frown lines, forehead creases, and crow's feet while preserving your natural expressions.
benefits: Smooths frown lines and forehead creases
Reduces crow's feet and dynamic wrinkles
botox.resultsDetail: Visible within 3-5 days, full effects at 10-14 days. Results last 4-6 months depending on skin type and muscle activity.

fillers.title: Dermal Fillers
fillers.shortDescription: Hyaluronic acid fillers for lip, cheek, and jawline enhancement with immediate, natural-looking results.
fillers.description: Hyaluronic acid fillers restore volume, define contours, and enhance facial harmony. We don't overfill — we refine. From lip enhancement to jawline definition, every treatment is tailored to your unique facial anatomy.
benefits: Lip volume, hydration, and border definition
fillers.resultsDetail: Immediate results with minimal downtime. Results last 6-18 months depending on the area and product used.

mesotherapy.title: Mesotherapy
mesotherapy.shortDescription: Minimally invasive skin rejuvenation via customized blends of hyaluronic acid, vitamins, peptides, and antioxidants.
mesotherapy.description: Mesotherapy delivers a customized blend of hyaluronic acid, vitamins, peptides, and antioxidants directly into the mesodermal layer of your skin. This deep nourishment activates natural regeneration for a brighter, smoother, more hydrated complexion.
benefits: Treats fine lines and loss of elasticity
Treats face, neck, decollete, and hands
mesotherapy.resultsDetail: Quick sessions with minimal downtime. Progressive improvement over a series of treatments.

skinBoosters.title: Skin Boosters
skinBoosters.shortDescription: Micro-injections of soft, stabilized hyaluronic acid for deep hydration and natural radiance.
skinBoosters.description: Skin Boosters deliver micro-injections of soft, stabilized hyaluronic acid deep into your skin — not for volume, but for hydration. They stimulate collagen production and increase cellular hydration for smoother, plumper, more radiant skin.
skinBoosters.resultsDetail: Visible results within weeks. Recommended as a series for sustained improvement or seasonal maintenance.

biostimulator.title: Biostimulator
biostimulator.shortDescription: Injectables that rebuild your skin's inner structure through natural collagen stimulation.
biostimulator.description: Biostimulators go beyond traditional fillers — they rebuild your skin's inner structure. Using Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) or Calcium hydroxyapatite (CaHA), they activate fibroblast activity and regenerate connective tissue for a natural lift and enhanced structure.
biostimulator.resultsDetail: Progressive results over weeks with continued improvement for months. Ideal for those seeking gradual, regenerative improvement.

prp.title: PRP Face & Scalp Rejuvenation
prp.shortDescription: Platelet-Rich Plasma therapy harnesses your body's regenerative potential for face and scalp rejuvenation.
prp.description: PRP therapy uses your body's own regenerative potential. A small blood draw is processed through a specialized centrifuge to isolate platelets and growth factors, which are then micro-injected into facial skin or scalp to stimulate natural healing and regeneration.
benefits: Reduces hair loss and promotes new growth
Minimally invasive with virtually no downtime
prp.resultsDetail: Gradual results as your body's natural regenerative processes activate over time.

bodyTreatments.title: Body Treatments
bodyTreatments.shortDescription: Advanced body aesthetics combining technologies with medical-grade products for contouring and cellulite smoothing.
bodyTreatments.description: Our body treatments combine advanced technologies with medical-grade products to address localized fat deposits, cellulite, and skin texture concerns. Customized protocols target the abdomen, thighs, hips, and arms for visible contouring and smoothing.
benefits: Customized protocols for your body type
bodyTreatments.resultsDetail: Progressive results over a series of sessions. Non-surgical, safe, with minimal downtime.

hyperhidrosis.title: Hyperhidrosis Treatment
hyperhidrosis.shortDescription: Clinically proven botulinum toxin microinjections to control excessive sweating effectively and comfortably.
hyperhidrosis.description: Hyperhidrosis treatment uses botulinum toxin (Botox) microinjections to control excessive sweating in the underarms, palms, soles, and forehead. A clinically proven, highly effective method delivered with comfort and discretion.
hyperhidrosis.resultsDetail: Results last 6-9 months. Medical excellence combined with elegant care.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: At Dermancy Medical House, your privacy matters. We collect personal information through contact forms (name, email, message), appointment booking (name, email, phone, preferred date/time), and automatic data (IP address, browser type, pages visited). We use this information to respond to inquiries, schedule appointments, improve our website, and ensure security. We do not sell or rent personal data. We use Google Analytics with cookies for website analytics. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data. You have rights to access, correct, and delete your personal data depending on your location.
